description: On-chain Observations: from an explicit address, transaction hash or contract address on a public ledger to cited transaction observations (transfers in and out, counterparties, contract deployment and first-funding chain) and probable address clustering with declared heuristics, a null model and a measured false-positive rate. Labels are quoted from their sources; no entity attribution is asserted.

profiles.description: Ledger-observation vocabulary: facts are cited to explorers, clusters are probable, labels are quotations

vocabulary.observation: explorer-reported ledger fact at a stated chain head
vocabulary.cluster: addresses probably controlled together (never by whom)
vocabulary.label: what a named public dataset states, quoted with attribution

requires.reason: the bundle's own entry points use these operations
the bundle's own entry points use these operations
label references to organization or contract entities are reviewed, reversible identity decisions

optional_features.description: Bounded, receipted acquisition of explorer observations for one explicit identifier per request; Ethereum stays inert (no_provider_configured) until NOESIS_ETHERSCAN_API_KEY is set

requires.reason: sources, licences and budgets are declared in the onchain-observations source pack

exclusions: person attribution or de-anonymization of an address
never: state that an address belongs to anyone
restate a quoted label as a finding
link an address to a person entity

query_examples.intent: What moved in and out of this address
query_examples.semantics: cited transactions and transfers with coverage and unknowns; unknown when never acquired

query_examples.intent: Who deployed this contract and who funded the deployer
query_examples.semantics: cited deployer and first-funding chain; unacquired hops stay unknown

query_examples.intent: Which addresses are probably controlled together with this one
query_examples.semantics: probable cluster with heuristic per edge, caveat, null model and measured FPR; no owner field
